cohort: The study included a sample of 17,177 pregnant women in the Region of Lleida, Spain, from 2012 to 2018.
finding: Among pregnant women, 2.5% had a diagnosis of depressive disorder and 24% were prescribed antidepressant treatment, but only 25% showed adequate adherence, with no relationship observed between adherence and age, BMI, diabetes mellitus, or country of origin.
